mapper.update: UPDATE id_user SET public_id = SHA2(CONCAT('deleted:', #{requestId}, ':public:', id), 256), registration_key = SHA2(CONCAT('deleted:', #{requestId}, ':registration:', id), 256), registration_digest = SHA2(CONCAT('deleted:', #{requestId}, ':digest:', id), 256), deleted = 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'CLOSED' AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM id_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1
